{"metadata":{"description":"输入框提示词联想插件：助手回复结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里，Tab 采纳、Esc 忽略 ｜ Codex-style composer prompt predictions for DeepSeek Harness: your next message ghosted into the composer, accepted with Tab.","id":"gh:1422457585","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-prompt-predict","slug":"ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","ghost-text","prompt-prediction"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"输入框提示词联想插件：助手回复结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里，Tab 采纳、Esc 忽略 ｜ Codex-style composer prompt predict"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ions for DeepSeek Harness: your next message ghosted into the composer, accepted with Tab."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-prompt-predict"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"After each reply, your next prompt is ghosted right into the composer — Tab to accept, Esc to dismis"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s, start typing and it's gone"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"🌏 中文 · English"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`dsh-prompt-predict` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin: after every assistant turn it predicts **the mess"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"age you are most likely to type next** and floats it into the composer as gray ghost text. The sugge"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"stion never enters the editor — only pressing `Tab` inserts it, and even then it stays undoable — so"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" a wrong prediction costs you nothing."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Single-line or multi-line** — sentences stay one line; code snippets, lists and multi-paragraph "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"replies keep their line breaks and indentation
- **A suggestion the moment a reply ends** — gray gho"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"st text rendered at the composer's first character, matching the editor's caret position, font size "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"and line height
- **Three interactions** — `Tab` to accept, `↻` (or `↓`) for a different suggestion,"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" `Esc` to dismiss; typing hides it, and clearing the draft brings it back
- **Lightweight context** "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"— only the most recent user/assistant *text*; tool results, attachments and system prompts never lea"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ve your machine
- **Follows the current session model by default** — nothing is hard-coded to a prov"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ider, the prediction call reuses whatever model the session itself uses; you can also pin a cheaper "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"model
- **No repeats, no dead ends** — a repeat of the previous suggestion triggers an automatic "gi"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ve me a different one"; a reasoning level the real model doesn't support falls back automatically, s"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"o you never hit "settings look fine but no suggestion ever appears"
- **Everything is adjustable** —"},{"id":"p8s12","text":" on/off, provider / model, response timeout, context size and budget, output cap, reasoning effort; "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"changes apply immediately, no DSH restart
- **Light and dark** — the ghost text, settings page and h"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"istory follow the system/app colour scheme (`prefers-color-scheme`), with contrast kept at WCAG AA i"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"n both
- **The UI follows your language** — the plugin ships dictionaries for the languages DSH itse"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"lf supports (Chinese and English), and passes every dictionary it has to the locale service. Switch "},{"id":"p8s17","text":"Settings → Language and the whole plugin UI changes at once, including the ghost hint above the comp"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"oser **and the validation errors inside Settings** (those are produced by the host, which answers in"},{"id":"p8s19","text":" the language the client sends); no reload needed, and it falls back to Chinese when no locale servi"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"ce is present
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — plain ESM on both the host and client side"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 🚀 Installation"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The plugin is published on npm. Options are ordered by convenience."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Install inside DSH (recommended)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**GUI**: open the plugins page → **Add plugin** → enter the package name `dsh-prompt-predict` → inst"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"I**: open the plugins page → **Add plugin** → enter the package name `dsh-prompt-predict` → install."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Or the dsh CLI** — pin any published version with pnpm's `@version` syntax:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Replace `--profile` with your own profile (usually `desktop` on the desktop app, `web` for the web b"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"uild), then **restart DSH**."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Upgrade to the latest release**"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Verified on **DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`** (web build; the desktop app runs the same host and client code)
-"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" `node` / `pnpm`: the install script prefers DSH's own runtime under `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/*/dependen"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"cies` and only falls back to `PATH`
- macOS / Linux; Windows untested"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 🧩 How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Host side** (`lib/`)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. `lib/index.js` is the plugin entry point and registers the same-origin HTTP route
2. On `suggest`"},{"id":"p23s2","text":", `lib/predict.mjs` trims the session down to the most recent user/assistant plain text — walking ba"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ckwards under both a message-count limit and a character budget
3. That trimmed history is **framed "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"as a single request-only user input** before it reaches the helper model: DSH assistant messages mus"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"t carry a full `stream` / `replayState`, so a trimmed fragment cannot masquerade as one (same approa"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ch session-title uses)
4. The streamed reply is normalized (code fences, `Suggestion:` prefixes and "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"wrapping quotes stripped, newlines collapsed) and returned to the client"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"For model selection, `provider` / `model` set to `auto` means "follow the session": no route is hard"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"-coded onto the helper call, and `predictNextPrompt` inherits whatever the session itself selected."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Client side** (`client/`)"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Injects into the `conversation.composer.dock` (lifecycle mount point next to the composer) and `se"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ttings.section` slots
- The ghost text is an **overlay** — it is never written into the Lexical edit"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"or; only accepting goes through `inputActions.insertText`"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## 🔐 Security and cost"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **One** small helper call per assistant turn by default; an extra attempt only happens when the re"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ply hits the length limit, the reasoning level needs downgrading, or a suggestion needs rerolling — "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"**four calls is the hard ceiling** (primary, reasoning-level fallback, length retry, reroll), and th"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ey share a single timeout budget
- Suggestions are **not written to the session log**; only after yo"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"u accept with `Tab` and send does the text become a real message
- Only trimmed user/assistant plain"},{"id":"p28s6","text":" text is sent — tool results, attachments and system prompts never leave the machine
- Both the sett"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ings page and the suggestion endpoint sit behind DSH's own browser-cookie authentication"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## ⚠️ Known limitations"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Verified only on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`; other versions untested
- Depends on the host's `conversation.c"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"omposer.dock` and `settings.section` slot names — a major DSH update may require adapting
- Predicti"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ons consume quota on the selected model; pinning a fast small model is cheaper than following a reas"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" quota on the selected model; pinning a fast small model is cheaper than following a reasoning model"}],"truncated":true}
